description: Built-in MCP JSON interfaces; account-discovered sport tools are added at runtime.

tools.name: get_steps
tools.description: Read steps for one YYYY-MM-DD date. Missing is not zero; demo is synthetic.

tools.name: list_data_types
tools.description:
Discover supported Garmin endpoints and required arguments without accessing credentials.

        Coverage is the documented API catalog, not a guarantee your account/device has data.
        Single/range queries expose all response fields, including new fields Garmin may add.

tools.name: get_garmin_data
tools.description:
Read original JSON from any dataset in list_data_types.

        Range endpoints accept <=31 inclusive days per call (steps/stress <=28).
        Dedicated health tools automatically chunk longer ranges. Activities: limit 1–100,
        advance start for subsequent pages. Use only data relevant to the user's request.
        Errors are explicit; no_data does not mean zero or lack of permission.

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: Read detailed sleep, stages, naps and Garmin scores for a YYYY-MM-DD date.

tools.name: get_heart_rate
tools.description: Read daily heart-rate measurements and resting heart rate for one date.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description:
Read activities with automatic pagination, up to 1000 records / 366 days.

        Inspect complete; if false, narrow dates or continue through get_garmin_data.
        Examples of activity_type: running, cycling, strength_training; use Garmin type keys.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description:
Read one activity's full summary, metadata, measurements, splits and optionally workouts.

        Use returned units and original data for per-session running/swimming/gym reviews.

tools.name: download_activity
tools.description:
Download Garmin's original activity ZIP to private local storage, without extracting it.

        For detailed analysis/export when JSON is insufficient. Max 32 MB. Does not modify Garmin.
        Returns a local path and archive member names; no credential or binary content in chat.

tools.name: get_health_overview
tools.description:
Integrated dashboard data for <=90 days: sleep, HR/HRV, steps, stress, Body Battery,
        activities and local strength logs. Reports per-metric coverage and partial failures.
        Sensitive optional datasets such as food and menstrual records require explicit raw queries.

tools.name: analyze_training
tools.description:
Descriptive health/training trends and recent 7-day vs preceding 7-day comparison.

        Prefer >=14 days for comparison. No causality, injury prediction or readiness score.
        Includes sport-specific duration/distance/pace and local strength progression.

tools.name: log_workout
tools.description:
Save USER-SUPPLIED workout notes/sets locally. One item per set; kg/lb explicit.

        Reuse record_id on retries. replace=true explicitly corrects a record and preserves history.
        Never invent weights/reps or silently add measured Garmin totals again. No Garmin writes.

tools.name: list_workout_logs
tools.description: Read user-entered workout sets and notes by inclusive dates, independently of Garmin.

tools.name: analyze_strength_progress
tools.description:
Compare recorded sets, reps, kg loads and volume by exercise; keep assisted loads separate.

        Estimated 1RM is an explicitly labeled Epley estimate for external-load sets <=10 reps.

tools.name: save_coach_profile
tools.description:
Persist user-stated goals, availability, equipment, limitations and timezone locally.
        Requires replace=true to change an existing profile; do not infer or invent profile details.

tools.name: get_coach_profile
tools.description: Read the user's saved coaching preferences; empty means not provided.

tools.name: prepare_coaching_context
tools.description:
Gather evidence and preferences for the LLM to draft a personalized running/fitness plan.

        Use 28–90 recent days when available. This returns evidence, not an automatically prescribed plan.
        Ask for missing preferences, explain adjustments and uncertainty, then optionally save the draft.

tools.name: save_training_plan
tools.description:
Save a requested LLM-authored plan and its evidence window locally; default status is draft.
        Does not send workouts to Garmin, schedule reminders or mark sessions completed.

tools.name: list_training_plans
tools.description: Read saved local training plans and their rationale, status, sessions and assumptions.

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description:
Create a private local HTML dashboard and JSON snapshot for <=90 days.
        Includes trends, sport totals, coverage and workout notes. Files are not published.

tools.name: get_activity_workouts
tools.description: Read structured workout steps associated with one completed Garmin activity as JSON.

tools.name: get_steps_history
tools.description: Daily steps, distance and goals; original Garmin JSON. Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates, at most 366 days; automatically split into bounded requests. Check complete and partial errors.

tools.name: get_stress
tools.description: Daily stress; original Garmin JSON. Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates, at most 366 days; automatically split into bounded requests. Check complete and partial errors.

tools.name: get_body_battery

tools.name: get_hrv_summaries

tools.name: get_wellness_activities

tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: Daily wellness summary; original Garmin JSON. Provide a YYYY-MM-DD date.

tools.name: get_hrv
tools.description: Detailed HRV; original Garmin JSON. Provide a YYYY-MM-DD date.

tools.name: get_food_logs

tools.name: get_spo2

tools.name: get_fitness_age
tools.description: Garmin fitness age; original Garmin JSON. Provide a YYYY-MM-DD date.

tools.name: get_menstrual_summary
tools.description: Menstrual cycle summary; only request when relevant; original Garmin JSON. Provide a YYYY-MM-DD date.

tools.name: get_menstrual_day
tools.description: Detailed menstrual day view; requires today_date; original Garmin JSON. Provide both date and today_date as YYYY-MM-DD; query only when relevant to the user.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Garmin profile settings; original Garmin JSON. No date parameters.

tools.name: get_heart_rate_zones
tools.description: Configured heart-rate zones; original Garmin JSON. No date parameters.

tools.name: get_respiration
tools.description: Read daily respiration as JSON over inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates (<=366 days). Projects the original respiration object from daily_summaries, preserving Garmin units and nulls. This is a filtered view of the documented daily-summary endpoint, not a separate Garmin API route.

tools.name: get_calories
tools.description: Read daily calories as JSON over inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates (<=366 days). Projects the original calories object from daily_summaries, preserving Garmin units and nulls. This is a filtered view of the documented daily-summary endpoint, not a separate Garmin API route.

tools.name: get_intensity_minutes
tools.description: Read daily intensity minutes as JSON over inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates (<=366 days). Projects the original intensityMinutes object from daily_summaries, preserving Garmin units and nulls. This is a filtered view of the documented daily-summary endpoint, not a separate Garmin API route.

tools.name: get_movement
tools.description: Read daily movement as JSON over inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates (<=366 days). Projects the original movement object from daily_summaries, preserving Garmin units and nulls. This is a filtered view of the documented daily-summary endpoint, not a separate Garmin API route.

tools.name: get_heart_rate_summary
tools.description: Read daily heart rate summary as JSON over inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates (<=366 days). Projects the original heartRate object from daily_summaries, preserving Garmin units and nulls. This is a filtered view of the documented daily-summary endpoint, not a separate Garmin API route.

An empty result does not prove no exercise.

tools.name: list_workout_types
tools.description:
List separately callable sport tools without network or credentials.
        Built-in filters are not an exhaustive Garmin taxonomy or evidence of account data.
        Use discover_workout_types to add sports observed in your history.

tools.name: discover_workout_types
tools.description:
Discover sport types in <=366 days of activities and add independent JSON tools.
        Persist only valid type keys locally for future sessions. No Garmin writes.
        max_records <=1000; inspect complete. New tools may require client reconnection.
        Demo registers synthetic types in memory only and never writes the journal.
